records.text: The Air Force Academy Board of Visitors has 15 other members who recommend changes to the Defense Secretary and report annually on the academy's morale, finances, and academics.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: With this appointment, Erika (Erika Kirk) joins just 15 other members. That's how exclusive this board is. They're responsible for making recommendations to the Defense Secretary, Pete Hegseth. regarding changes to the Air Force Academy. verification.notes: The official 2024-2026 charter confirms the board advises the Defense Secretary through the Air Force Secretary and reviews morale, curriculum, fiscal affairs, and academics. The statement is materially right about duties but wrong on membership count and reporting frequency.
